rawValueRestrictions.color: Never emit raw hex/lab/oklch in generated output; reference semantic.* or component.*.
rawValueRestrictions.type: Use type.* classes; do not set raw font-size/letter-spacing.

enforcement.pageSpec: PageSpecs carry NO per-instance style/token field; styling is owned by section contracts. Token policy therefore applies to implementers, and is drift-checked at the catalog level by extraction/verify_all.py (policy keys must exist in the catalog).

overrides: None permitted. There is no PageSpec field for token overrides (by design, see enforcement.pageSpec).
darkMode: Not present in source - do not generate.
